policy.primaryBackend: DX9Ex remains the protected reference baseline; HUD, performance, DXVK and DX12 are independent parallel development/test tracks and none may block the others.
policy.backendReplacementGate: DXVK/DX12 may be developed, built and HMD-tested in parallel; only promotion to protected/default backend requires Quest3/VDXR parity with R51.

parallelTracks.HUD: B/C/D continue exact semantic-lifetime and world-marker work independently.
parallelTracks.PERFORMANCE: D/C continue dense-scene/frame-budget optimization without waiting for HUD completion.
parallelTracks.DXVK: A/C/D resume x86 DXVK SAFE compatibility first, then multiview optimization after SAFE evidence.
parallelTracks.DX12: A/C/D resume D3D9On12 device/resource compatibility and HMD test preparation independently of HUD.

pcRunnerAuthorization.rule: Scheduled overnight work may review/analyze/use normal cloud CI, but must not dispatch or trigger self-hosted PC builds until the user explicitly opens a new PC-build session.

eveningHmdMatrix.rule: Parallel HMD experiment preparation is allowed from one TEST_MATRIX_BASE; experiment slots are test-only until HMD evidence and exact-tree validation.
frozenPrimaryWork: broad EXE-map expansion unrelated to active HUD/flare/backend work
generic dependency/toolchain cleanup unrelated to active builds
eveningHmdMatrix.nonBlockingRule: A failure or delay in HUD/FLARE must not block PERF, DXVK or DX12 implementation/build/test preparation. A backend failure must not block HUD/FLARE work.

automationCycle.rule: Each cycle performs recover/review/implement/validate/integrate. Remote claim/CAS prevents collisions. Waiting on one lane must not idle the cycle.

implementationFirstEnforcement.sameCycleRule: If safe without HMD, implement or deterministically validate in the same full cycle; documentation alone is not completion.
implementationFirstEnforcement.ciPendingRule: Persist exact immutable SHA/run then advance another non-conflicting lane; never idle or busy-poll.
implementationFirstEnforcement.staleQueueRule: If source already contains the fix, correct the queue and add/persist a regression verifier instead of recreating the fix.
implementationFirstEnforcement.hmdGateRule: Use NEED_HMD_TEST only for genuinely hardware-visible uncertainty after deterministic gates are exhausted.
implementationFirstEnforcement.endOfCycleGate: Scan actionable states and continue useful independent work until only HMD gates, active immutable CI, ownership conflict, or hard capability blockers remain.
